name: Hagia Sophia
text: Justinian's great church has crowned the city for nine hundred years.

name: St Peter's
text: Pilgrims from every Christian land come to the Apostle's tomb.

name: The Duomo
text: Brunelleschi's dome, closed in 1436, the widest raised since Rome fell.

name: Dome of the Rock
text: Its golden dome rises over Jerusalem's holy rock and its pilgrim roads.

name: Notre-Dame
text: The cathedral on the island in the Seine, two centuries in the building.

name: St Stephen's
text: Its spire, finished in 1433, watches over Vienna and the Danube.

name: Westminster
text: Where England's kings are crowned and its parliaments sit.

name: The Alhambra
text: The red palace of the Nasrid emirs, all courts and running water.

name: The Kremlin
text: Walls and towers ring the Grand Prince's citadel above the river.

name: The Arsenal
text: Venice's great shipyard can fit out a galley in a day.

name: The Pyramids
text: The tombs of Egypt's ancient kings, older than any memory.

name: Templo Mayor
text: The great twin temple at the heart of Tenochtitlan.

name: Djinguereber
text: Timbuktu's great mosque of earth and timber, a seat of learning.

name: Charles Bridge
text: Sixteen stone arches carry the road over the Vltava.

name: The Giralda
text: Seville's old minaret, now a bell tower, rises over its river port.
